newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI buys July forward dollars, spot steady.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI buys July forward dollars, spot steady.

text.p: The rupee dropped mildly against the forward dollar on Monday on Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention, dealers said.
RBI bought July dollars, pushing up the premium by one paisa, they said.
Most dealers said the purchases were rollovers of earlier forward deals. "The premium levels are very attractive," said a dealer.
Forward dollar purchases also help postpone injection of liquidity in the domestic money market, he said.
RBI has been buying spot dollars in recent weeks to mop up excess dollar supply and arrest the rupee's rise.
Spot dollar was quoted steady at 35.817/822 rupees.
